clue.text: I'd return to break agreement in dispute

indicators.note: to break open means the agreement word is split and the other piece set inside it

parts.note: a contract is a formal agreement

indicators.note: return says the letters of I'd are read back the other way

parts.note: I'd, the apostrophe ignored, gives its two letters

explanation.surface: Someone withdraws from a deal that has run into a dispute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns ID into DI, and 'to break' puts DI inside CONTRACT.
explanation.definitionFit: To deny or argue against a statement is to dispute it.

clue.text: Instrument poor Martin's left is a trombone

indicators.note: left says letters are left out of the next word, taken away from it

parts.note: poor shows the letters of Martin are jumbled; those found in the brass word (T, R, M, N) are the ones removed

explanation.surface: A badly played trombone is all that remains of Martin's instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: Strike from TROMBONE the letters it shares with MARTIN (T, R, M, N) and OBOE is left over.
explanation.definitionFit: An oboe is a double-reed woodwind instrument.

clue.text: One who cares to make an offer

explanation.surface: A carer is also someone who bids.
explanation.definitionFit: A tender looks after someone (as in a bar tender or nurse), and to tender is to put forward a formal bid.

clue.text: Goes up when the hundred is over

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
something that is over ends

explanation.surface: A batsman climbs the rankings once his century is reached.
explanation.definitionFit: To climb or rise is the plain synonym.

clue.text: One person of intelligence provides word-game for children

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
intelligence here is espionage, so its agent is a spy

explanation.surface: A clever person supplies a game of words for the kids.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intelligence' looks like brains, but it is secret information gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the guessing game where players name objects starting with a given letter.

clue.text: Raise one's voice after drink — causing annoyance

indicators.note: after places the singing word behind the drink word

parts.note: tea is a drink
to sing is to raise one's voice in song

explanation.surface: Someone shouts after a few drinks and becomes a nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: Taunting or provoking someone playfully causes them irritation.

clue.text: Car, since it had overhaul, is found in order

indicators.note: an overhaul takes something apart and puts it back together, so these letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A car that has been serviced is found to be in working order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'had overhaul' rearranges CAR SINCE IT; 'in order' means in working condition on the surface but a religious order in the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Cistercians are monks of a religious order founded at Cîteaux.

clue.text: Work on project for film

indicators.note: on places the work word next to the projecting word

parts.note: to screen a film is to project it
a play is a dramatic work

explanation.surface: Someone works on a projection in preparation for a film.
explanation.definitionFit: The script of a film, with dialogue and directions, is what the definition stands for.

clue.text: American leaves a field event with a record

indicators.note: leaves says the American word departs from the event word

parts.note: the discus is a throwing event in athletics

explanation.surface: An American athlete abandons a field event after setting a record.
explanation.definitionFit: A gramophone record is a flat disc.

clue.text: Our panic moderated after company provides abundant supply

indicators.note: after puts the rearranged letters behind the company abbreviation
moderated means altered or toned down, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Our alarm subsided once the firm delivered plenty of stock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moderated' rearranges OUR PANIC into RNUCOPIA, set after CO.
explanation.definitionFit: The horn of plenty symbolises an overflowing store of good things.

clue.text: Pay for a seat

explanation.surface: Paying for somewhere to sit.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle a bill is to pay it, and a settle is a high-backed wooden bench.

clue.text: Word play

explanation.surface: A game of words.
explanation.definitionFit: In the parlour game a word is acted out syllable by syllable, and a pretence put on for show is a piece of play-acting.

clue.text: Pin-up of uncovered tart?

explanation.surface: A glamour shot of a scantily clad woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamour photographs of attractive people are called this, and it is also a dessert baked as an open tart with no pastry lid.

clue.text: Charge for fire-arms

parts.note: reads like a price for guns, but a charge is the explosive load a gun fires

explanation.definitionFit: Bullets and shells make up the charge loaded into guns.

clue.text: Presley lives anew!

indicators.note: anew means made again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tabloid claims the King of rock and roll is alive again.
explanation.definitionFit: The singer Presley's first name.

clue.text: Bar and a club

parts.note: taken as written
an iron is a golf club

explanation.surface: A pub and a golf club side by side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bar' suggests a pub, but here it is a metal rod.
explanation.definitionFit: A metal support, one of a pair holding logs in a fireplace, is a kind of bar.

clue.text: Tricky performance as an act in variety

indicators.note: variety means a different arrangement, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tricky turn on stage counts as an act in a variety show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variety' (the variety show of the surface) rearranges ACT IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A grotesque or playful caper is a piece of clowning.

clue.text: The weapon attached to one's hook gets dumped

definitions.text: attached to one's hook gets dumped

explanation.surface: A weapon fixed to someone's hook is thrown away.
explanation.walkthrough: To 'sling your hook' is British slang for clear off; the second definition plays on sling meaning throw away.
explanation.definitionFit: A strap for hurling stones is a weapon, and to toss something away is to throw it out.

clue.text: She takes me back to mother

indicators.note: to joins the mother word on after the turned word
back says the word me is read the other way round

parts.note: taken as written
ma is mother

explanation.surface: A girl drives me home to my mother.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, so a female person, standing in for the pronoun.

clue.text: Notice of proposed legislation

explanation.surface: An announcement about a planned law.
explanation.definitionFit: A poster or handbill is a notice, and a draft law before parliament is one too.

clue.text: Numbers of Romans about the city

parts.note: C, IV and I are Roman numerals (100, 4 and 1)
C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Counting Romans around the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to a town or its citizens, as in civic pride.

clue.text: Some cleric ran merry until burnt at the stake

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A clergyman made merry until being burnt as a heretic.
explanation.walkthrough: Thomas Cranmer, Archbishop of Canterbury, was burnt at the stake in 1556.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudor archbishop was executed by burning under Mary I.

clue.text: Greek character possibly seen as oriental

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: possibly says the letters may be in another order

explanation.surface: A man from Greece might be taken for someone from the Far East.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something from China is from the Orient.

clue.text: No rises for those more advanced in service

indicators.note: something in for a service is being stripped down and reassembled, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Staff complain that long years of service bring no pay rises.
explanation.definitionFit: Older people, or those of higher rank, are the elders.

clue.text: Pot smoker

parts.note: reads as a cannabis user, but the smoking thing carries a pot on top

explanation.definitionFit: The flue on a roof, topped with a pot, gives out smoke.

clue.text: Artistic piece-work

parts.note: piece-work usually means paid by output, but here it is art made from small pieces

explanation.definitionFit: A picture assembled from small tiles or stones is art made of pieces.

clue.text: Bed not turned — but the sheets may be

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

indicators.note: turned says the word not is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: The bed hasn't been turned down, though its sheets might be.
explanation.definitionFit: Bed linen is often woven from this plant fibre.

clue.text: It operates at different levels

parts.note: sounds like a sophisticated scheme but describes something that carries people from floor to floor

explanation.definitionFit: An elevator moves between the floors of a building.

clue.text: One-time or one time

explanation.definitionFit: Formerly, as in a one-time champion, and on a single occasion.

clue.text: Relative to help people out, a social worker around university

indicators.note: people out means the people word goes on the outside of the help word

parts.note: men are people
aid is help

indicators.note: around has the worker word circling the university abbreviation

parts.note: the ant is a social insect, a worker in its colony

explanation.surface: A relative goes to help people out, like a social worker at a university.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' is not a carer but an ant, a social insect.
explanation.definitionFit: An unmarried older female relation is the stock family figure meant.

clue.text: Boss sounds a toff

indicators.note: sounds says the word for a toff is heard, not written

parts.note: a nob is a toff, an upper-class person

explanation.surface: The boss comes across as a posh snob.
explanation.walkthrough: A boss is also a round knob or stud.
explanation.definitionFit: A boss is a raised round stud or ornament, like a handle.

clue.text: Returns to digs for economy's sake

definitions.text: Returns to digs for economy's sake

parts.words: Returns to digs for economy's sake
parts.note: read as going back to cheap lodgings to save money, and as re- (again) plus the digs of excavated ditches

explanation.definitionFit: To cut back spending to save money is to economise.
